event_summary: A bright flash around a black rectangular container is followed by a large white vapor cloud expanding upward and to the right in a snowy outdoor scene.
raw_event_description: The sequence begins with a strong white-yellow glare filling much of the frame and obscuring the central area. As the glare fades, a black rectangular container is visible on snow in front of a low snowy dirt berm. A white cloud appears above the container, grows into a dense rounded mass, rises higher, and expands outward. The cloud becomes large enough to cover much of the background and extends strongly to the right while the container remains mostly stationary and increasingly obscured.

reasons: A bright white-yellow glare overexposes most of the central frame.
The central container and nearby ground details are largely obscured in the first frame.
The snowy ground and distant berm are only partly visible through the glare.

initial_relation_observations.relation_description: The container is positioned on the snow-covered ground near the center foreground.
The container is in front of the snowy dirt berm.
The white cloud appears directly above the container.
The bright glare is centered over the same region where the container later becomes visible.

evidence_bank.observation: A white-yellow overexposed glare fills most of the central and lower frame.
After the glare fades, a black rectangular container is visible on snowy ground.
A low white cloud is visible directly above the container.
The white cloud grows upward into a rounded mound above the container.
The white cloud expands laterally beyond the width of the container.
Wispy white portions are visible near the lower left and lower right edges of the container.
The expanding cloud partially hides the snowy dirt berm behind it.
A large part of the cloud extends toward the right side of the frame.
The cloud forms a tall dense vertical column above the container.
The right side of the cloud reaches far to the right and partly out of the frame.
The top opening area of the container is mostly hidden by the low white cloud layer.
The container remains in the same ground position while the cloud continues to move and change shape above it.
The container and background ridge keep approximately fixed image positions throughout the sequence.
No visible scene cut occurs during the sequence.

observations: The frame begins with strong central overexposure.
The black rectangular container becomes visible as the glare fades.
A white cloud appears above the container.

object_events.observation: The bright glare diminishes and reveals more of the scene.
The container becomes visible in a fixed position on the snowy ground.
The white cloud appears as a low mound above the container.

observations: The white cloud grows taller and wider.
The background becomes increasingly hidden behind the cloud.
The cloud begins extending prominently to the right.

object_events.observation: The cloud expands upward into a rounded plume.
The cloud spreads laterally beyond the container edges.
The container remains stationary while its upper area becomes partly obscured.
The background berm is partially hidden by the cloud.

observations: A dense white column persists above the container.
The rightward portion of the cloud occupies much of the right side of the frame.
The container remains visible mainly as a dark rectangular lower shape.

object_events.observation: The cloud continues to billow and shift shape above and to the right of the container.
The container stays in place and is increasingly covered by the low cloud layer.
Large portions of the berm are hidden behind the white cloud.

unresolved_observations: The interior of the container is not visible after the cloud forms.
The exact source of the bright glare is not visible as a distinct object.
The white cloud obscures much of the container and background during the later frames.
